test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which state is the Thoseghar waterfall located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Thoseghar waterfall located in **Maharashtra.**
 
• Thoseghar waterfalls is a scenic spot located near the** small village of Thoseghar, 20 km from Satara city, at the edge of the Konkan region**, in Western India.
 
• There are a series of waterfalls, some of them **15 to 20 metres and one of approx 200 metres in height.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
